# BenQ XCSD Tool

**Author:** BenQ Mobile<br/>
**Platforms:** ODM

<div className="screenshot">

![BenQ XCSD Tool: screenshot 1](./benq-xcsd-tool/img/benq-xcsd-tool.png)

</div>

Service software for BenQ and BenQ-Siemens phones on the TI platform, as well as the P50. It loads main and language firmware, writes PPF configuration, saves and restores network and WAP settings and Media Center content, and removes locks.

Version L1 is intended for standard service updates. Version L2 additionally writes the boot file when restoring phones that do not power on. The L2 distribution was not found.
